text:
Type: white floating wall shelf
Use: displaying books, photos, plants and decor; living room, bedroom, home office, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: white painted fibreboard, smooth matte finish
Colors: white, soft off-white
Shape: long thick slab that seems to float on hidden fixings, squared ends, clean straight edges, chunky solid profile, medium visual weight
Feel: clean, calm, simple, modern
Goes with: white or colored walls, light wood, framed art, green plants; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: LACK
product.description: The shelf becomes one with the wall thanks to the concealed mounting hardware.
